text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Traveling straight from the summer camp grounds to Oi Racecourse,
the chaotic day of the Japan Dirt Derby had arrived—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! It's about to begin...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, just a little!
But you know, it's not a bad kind of nervous fluttering.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Time to show off Falco's real strength~!
...I guess this heartbeat is trembling with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for top dirt Umadol,
we're starting fresh from here!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Shall we head out—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
That girl over there seems a bit...

text_block_list.name: Brown Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —If even the dirt doesn't work out after all...

text_block_list.name: Brown Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No... I'm okay, I can win. I won't lose again.
I won't lose like that anymore. I can win, I can—"

text_block_list.name: Brown Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —I'll win...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
that girl is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, that Umamusume challenged a GⅠ turf race
just like Smart Falcon, carrying the expectations of the 3rd favorite, yet—
choice_data_list: That's the girl who came in dead last in her last race.
That's the girl who came in dead last in her last race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco feels the same about making a fresh start.
Still, the vibe she's giving off is practically electric...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Falco, so you really came back to the dirt.
Because it's not just her—"

text_block_list.name: Competing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Alright...!
Let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Competing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow past everyone and win!!
I'm not giving up the number one spot in the dirt...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes are glaring fiercely.
It's a bit of a different atmosphere
from the dream-filled air of the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone's equally serious, but it feels like... we're on the edge of a cliff, you know?
choice_data_list: Standing right on the edge is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, no, no! That's not what I meant!
I just meant they had that kind of fiery spirit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm looking down on dirt!
It's just... well... taking that leap
takes a whole lot of courage, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The phrasing may be strange, but the point comes across.
In this turf-centric country, many girls who fail to get
results on turf end up choosing dirt as a last resort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If they can't even produce results on dirtâ
some must be going in thinking they have nothing left to lose.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, Falco can't afford to lose either.
I can't let myself be swallowed up...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *Sharp posture!!*

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With an extra-sized helping of Falco's aura!
I'll swallow every last one of you up☆
